# Daily Briefing – Monday, 20 July

Yesterday was a rest day with 6,136 steps and 2,383 kcal burned — solid baseline activity. The real concern though is that 3.9 hours of sleep. That's not recovery, that's survival mode, and your body knows it.

Your HRV of 85ms sits noticeably below your 101-119ms baseline, which almost certainly reflects that sleep deficit. Interestingly, your resting HR of 53bpm and stress score of 32 look calm — so this isn't acute illness or overtraining, just poor sleep. Keep today's session light; a gentle 20-30 minute easy run or walk is fine, but skip anything intense until you've had a proper night's rest.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else — even nutrition. Aim for 8 hours. Hit your 175g protein today to protect muscle, but honestly, quality sleep will do more for your 17 May goal right now than any workout. Rest *is* training.
